$comment: The church's Communication Flows (docs/communication-flows-proposal.md and docs/communications.md#communication-flows). Each flow names its Ministry by Design category from configuration/categories.json, how people enter it, its messages from the message library in path order (an email key from emails.json or a text key from texts.json), its goal, and its exit rule. 'entry' is the step a person completes to enter an On-Demand flow: they join the run that starts the day after. 'skipIfGoalMet' leaves out people who already met the goal, as the workflow that adds them would check. 'daysToWait' counts from the previous message, as Rock does. 'historyMonths' is how far back the flow's runs reach. A run that started before install day and still has messages left stays open, and Rock's Process Communication Flows job sends the rest (decision D-comm-flows-1), so only people whose email is on 'reservedEmailDomain' or empty are ever in an open run.

flows.name: After Starting Point
flows.description: Follows up with everyone who finishes the Starting Point Class: a thank-you the next day, a small group invitation a week later, and an invitation to Foundations three weeks later.

flows.name: After Foundations
flows.description: Helps everyone who finishes Foundations and is not serving yet find their place to serve: a congratulations the next day, a text offering help finding a team, and volunteer stories two weeks later.

goal.$targetPercentComment: Set from the data: on Full 7, 11 of the 60 people not yet serving when they entered took the Serve step within 90 days (18%), rounded down to a whole 5%.

flows.name: Baptism Next Steps
flows.description: Walks with anyone thinking about baptism, from the day they fill out the Baptism Interest form: a welcome email, a text offering to answer questions, an email about baptism Sunday, and a text offering to save them a spot. It stops for each person the day their Baptism step is recorded.

entry.$comment: Who filled out the form. 'baptizedShare' percent of the people baptized here in the history window filled it out 1 to 16 weeks before their baptism; the rest signed up on the day. 'notBaptizedPerBaptized' as many people again, who are not baptized, filled it out at any time in the window. The pins are Cast stories: Josh Sanders filled it out 66 days before install, six days before his baptism, and one unbaptized Cast adult with a reserved email, picked by the loader, filled it out 30 days before install, so they are mid-flow.

workflows.name: Baptism Interest
workflows.description: The "I'm interested in baptism" form on the church website. It puts the person in the Baptism Next Steps Communication Flow.
workflows.formHeader:
Thinking about baptism?

We'd love to walk with you. Tell us a little about where you are, and a pastor will be in touch.
workflows.formFooter: Questions? Talk with a pastor at any campus on Sunday.
workflows.commentsLabel: Anything you want us to know?
